Content inside <template> is never rendered per the HTML spec and must not appear in the output

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><template><p>secret template text</p></template><p>also visible</p>")
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
